messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] org=monarchai rate_spike detected — 4xx+ errors and QPS up ~8x vs baseline over 5m. Pager: @maya_oncall. Incident link: https://incidents.redwood/4767770000

maya_oncall: On it. Paging SRE and ops to triage. Looking at pool utilization and error patterns now.

jason_ops: Seeing headroom exhaustion on eu-west1 GPU pool. Lots of long-tail latencies and streaming connections piling up. Customer burst originated from a scheduled campaign?

maya_oncall: Not sure. Initial plan: tactical rate-shielding for monarchai — cap org QPS, disable streaming for their tokens, and route to smaller model variant until we stabilize. Will apply a short window first (15m).

maya_oncall: Executing runbook step:
```
/rl adjust --org monarchai --qps 600 --duration 15m --reason "emergency spike shielding"
```

devex-bot: rl.adjust queued — request id=rl-7392. Applying changes to edge routers; expected propagation 20-40s.

jason_ops: Seeing changes start to apply across controllers. Backpressure on connection manager dropping new streams.

sally_cs: I'll draft a notice to MonarchAI engineering and CSM: "We detected an elevated traffic spike and applied a temporary throttling policy (QPS cap + disabled streaming) to protect platform stability. We're monitoring and will provide updates every 15 minutes." Happy to send now.

tim_sre: Taking handoff after initial mitigation. I'll also flip model routing to a smaller variant for their workspace to reduce token cost and latency amplification.

tim_sre: Running routing change:
```
/route set --org monarchai --model redwood-alpha-2-small --enforce true
```

jason_ops: Metrics update (2m after apply): 4xx error rate down from 12% -> 4%, aggregate QPS for monarchai ~580, p95 latency up ~80ms but stable. Connection churn reduced.

maya_oncall: Good signal. Keep 15m watch. If error rate climbs or QPS stays >750, prepare for capacity scale or org-specific temp quota bump rollback.

sally_cs: MonarchAI replied: "Thanks for the quick action — we've paused non-critical jobs and will await your update."

tim_sre: I'll extend the shielding window to 30m given stability and create follow-up ticket: INC-5234 for full postmortem + root cause. Assigning owner to @tim_sre.

maya_oncall: Handoff complete to @tim_sre, I'm stepping out for other pages. Leave me a summary in the ticket. :wave:

incident-bot: Update logged: mitigation applied (rl-7392), routing change executed (route-8841). Links: https://incidents.redwood/4767770000/mitigations 

jason_ops: Action items recorded in INC-5234: (1) review client burst guard triggers, (2) add preemptive per-org shielding in runbook, (3) telemetry alert to detect streaming spikes sooner.

tim_sre: Will run a short follow-up check at +20m and post a status update to the ticket. If all good, we revert model routing and remove the QPS cap.

sally_cs: Notifying MonarchAI CSM and adding copy to customer-facing incident note.

maya_oncall: Thanks team. Good quick coord.

(End of thread)
